title: Yuri 10mm Concrete Drill Bit, 110mm Total Length, 50mm Flute Length, ISO 9001, for AEG, Bosch, Hilti, Metabo Machines
description: The Yuri 10mm Concrete Drill Bit is a reliable and robust tool designed for precision drilling in concrete, masonry, and similar hard surfaces. Manufactured to ISO 9001 quality standards, this drill bit delivers consistent performance for both professional tradespeople and DIY enthusiasts alike. With a diameter of 10mm, a flute length of 50mm, and a total length of 110mm, it offers excellent reach and control for a wide range of drilling tasks. The SDS-style shank ensures a secure fit and efficient power transfer, minimising slippage during use. This drill bit is compatible with leading power tool brands including AEG, Bosch, Hilti, and Metabo, making it a versatile addition to your toolkit. The hardened carbide tip is engineered to cut through tough materials with ease, while the spiral flute design helps clear debris efficiently, keeping your work area clean and your drilling smooth. Whether you are mounting fixtures, installing anchors, or undertaking construction work, the Yuri 10mm Concrete Drill Bit is built to handle demanding jobs with durability and precision.
